<description>
This fixes an antithesis bug reported in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/35845 and similar bug reported in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/33387 where if asynchronous IPC mining calls are made when the node is shutting down it's possible for `assert(m_node.chainman)` to trigger. This happens because the `Ipc::disconnectIncoming` method does not wait for asynchronous calls to complete after it disconnects IPC clients, so they may continue to run as the node is shutting down.

This PR changes `disconnectIncoming` to wait for asynchronous calls to complete to avoid this issue. It's a draft because it depends on libmultiprocess changes, but should otherwise be ready to review.

**This is based on bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#361 and bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#335,** included through a `src/ipc/libmultiprocess` subtree update that also contains bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#377, which this PR does not need.

The non-base commits are:

- [`8a948e2bdd4` doc: Improve disconnect callback comments](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/8a948e2bdd4d2f48cd5a5c9ffd9e0660b0769c15)
- [`59f703760b2` doc: Improve Waiter/EventLoop lock order documentation](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/59f703760b292fdf5d35c36ef55298b58df11dc7)
- [`98533b0201e` proxy-io: fix listener stuck at capacity after a local disconnect](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/98533b0201e5eeb6b2c9c07c3e48525266fd9b3d)
- [`0b1730bad11` proxy-io: fix race deleting a disconnected Connection twice](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/0b1730bad1191e2a230962aaad2feeb83c003c4f)
- [`789775cb46c` proxy: Fix thread map teardown race causing use-after-free on disconnect](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/789775cb46cb95c1e697ff23d6f8b63be59caf82)
- [`580d9644a71` proxy-io: add Connection::disconnect() separating teardown from destruction](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/580d9644a712dc41588ed0c2fa35b2b6bda6eec3)
- [`bb588048d12` proxy-io: add Connection::waitDrained() to wait for in-flight server calls](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/bb588048d12dd3d331d01b736fcfd9092cdf6222)
- [`0ad96a7fab3` test: cover draining in-flight server call after disconnect](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/0ad96a7fab3293d663c3c2b0235f4741bbb9f6f7)
- [`d9ffa655294` ipc: use ServeStream/ConnectStream in Bitcoin Core IPC code](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/d9ffa65529468a88a2ad01852e2d643768314af8)
- [`dc293af2f43` ipc: drain in-flight server calls before shutdown frees node state](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/dc293af2f4319f6cee434ade12083e441aafaeea)
- [`01a01e35d97` lint: Skip subtree check for src/ipc/libmultiprocess](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35932/commits/01a01e35d9732268e09cfa524c55128389cccfd5)

### Status (2026-11-13)

This is a draft with no reviews yet. It waits on bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#361 and bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#335, both open, and on a subtree update that includes them. Neither has had new reviews since 2026-11-04; bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#335 still has open review comments from before.

- **Remaining work:**
  - Check whether the node may hang at exit when an IPC client is connected at shutdown, since the disconnected connections no longer appear to be destroyed (suspected from the code, not yet reproduced).
  - Add a test that stops the node with a call in progress, and update the code comment and commit message, which describe an earlier version of the change (the comment still says the connections are destroyed and names `mp::Connection::waitDrained`).
</description>
